threshold_sources.witness_G: E137 results/stage2.json G['Always on/k4/in2/s2']; repeated to the last digit by E139's control (results/control.json replay.G)

control.what: first, before any fine-tune is read: E137's witness regenerated by its seed and read against the hand-made Always on pair
control.expected: G 0.9225 (E139's control read 0.922475722997802 by the same code and seed), the pair's gap 0.14708

do_nothing: Not read here. The do-nothing state (the 67M itself) has gap 0, under E139's 0.02 floor, so G_witness is undefined (zero denominator) and no reading is given; nothing below can be met by it.

A1.claim: The witness's G against each of the three Always on fine-tunes lies in [0.570, 0.640]: at the pair's own read-out the fine-tune reads no higher than the search's best G (0.627 to 0.638), because the fine-tune's leftover distance to the pair (tv_to_F 0.0567 to 0.0569 against gaps 0.1585 to 0.1587) caps it.
A1.rule: Per seed, G_witness = 1 - mean TV(M[phi <- s(v_M)], fine-tune) / gap, on E139's read half (100,000 windows), gap = mean TV(fine-tune, M) on the same windows. Holds if 0.570 <= G_witness <= 0.640 on all 3 seeds; fails if G_witness > 0.640 on at least 2 seeds (the pair's read-out explains the fine-tune better than the search found: a search limit at the best site); otherwise reported as read, no call.
A1.edge_cases: Values exactly at 0.570 or 0.640 count as inside. A seed whose recomputed gap misses E139's stops the job (no partial call). The triangle inequality bounds G_witness to [1 - (d_pair + tv_to_F)/gap, 1 - (tv_to_F - d_pair)/gap], where d_pair = (1 - 0.9225) x 0.14708 = 0.0114: [0.5704, 0.7142], [0.5695, 0.7132], [0.5692, 0.7130] for seeds 0, 1, 2. A value outside its seed's bounds (written per seed as within_bounds) is a bug in the read, not a result. G_witness below 0.570 is therefore impossible unless the read is wrong, and above 0.794 is impossible, so this amendment cannot change a label.
A1.blind_to: Whether a better read-out than the pair's exists at another site or k; whether the fine-tune uses the pair's variable inside (G reads outputs only, E139 blind_to).

A2.claim: Descriptive: the witness's reversion against each fine-tune is low, near E139's in2 reversions (0.197 to 0.204), far below its reversion against the pair (0.938); the setter mismatch is reported beside the pair's 0.106.
A2.rule: Reported per seed; no call and no label reads them.
A2.edge_cases: Reversion depends on phi only, not on s; mismatch uses the variance convention of commute.variable_read.read_pair (zero variance: 0 if exact, else 1).
A2.blind_to: Whether a low reversion means the fine-tune's change sits after in2 or that the fine-tune's change is not in phi's span at all.

noise_floor: The witness is one fixed (phi, s): no start spread. The read is deterministic up to float order (E139's control repeated it to 1e-15). Seed-to-seed spread of the fine-tunes' gaps: 0.00017; of tv_to_F: 0.00019.
